ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show fee to the rider; notify the driver that a no-show cancellation requires GPS presence within 200 m of the designated pickup point (Gate A/Clarke Quay) and, when the driver repositions, a rider-agreed alternative meeting point.
ruling.reasoning:
The driver's own statement says it plainly: "I pressed I'm Here at Gate B." The system confirms he pressed it at Gate B, not at the pickup point. GPS shows him stationary on HILL STREET at 1.29130, 103.84765 from 21:26:00 (his "I'm Here" event / driver_arrived) to the 21:32:00 cancellation — a steady ~6 minutes with no movement. The pickup point is Clarke Quay at 1.2906, 103.8465 (Gate A, where the rider says he was). Straight-line distance ≈ 145 m but the on-road separation is ~200 m+ around the River Valley/Hill Street block, and in any event he was parked on a different road at a different gate — he never came to the rider. NS-1(i) requires arrival with GPS within 200 m of the pickup point; the driver's position at the designated pickup fails that condition and he explicitly refused to come to Gate A.

The other conditions don't rescue him. He did send in-app messages (21:26:30 "I'm at Gate B", 21:28:30 refusal, 21:31:50 cancellation notice) and made one in-app call (21:27:30, unanswered), satisfying the pre-cancellation contact prongs (iii). But (i) fails, and (iv) is moot since he was never at the pickup point. The rider's conduct — a single "I'm at Gate A, can you come here?" — is not a no-show; the rider was present and asking to be collected, and the driver's refusal to cover the ~200 m to Gate A was the driver's choice, not the rider's absence.

Since the $5.00 no-show fee was charged, NS-2 applies: any NS-1 condition failing means `refund_full` of the $5.00. The driver marking "I'm Here"/arrived while GPS was not at the pickup point (a different gate/road) is the exact situation NS-2 addresses, so the refund is full. NS-3 would also bar the fee since the driver in substance cancelled for a reason other than an established rider no-show (a rider who is present and waiting is not a no-show).

No safety issue is present: the chat is a routine pickup-location exchange over a double-yellow line, with no threat, harassment, dangerous-driving or inappropriate remark anywhere in the messages, complaint or driver statement.

The driver profile shows no prior upheld no-show/route deviations in 90 days, so RD-6 repeat-offender flagging does not apply on the no-show basis. I note the discrepancy between the driver's claim that Gate A "has a double yellow line" and the GPS road evidence (HILL STREET), but the outcome does not turn on it: whether Gate B or another point, GPS shows he was not at the Clarke Quay pickup point and he declined to come to the rider's indicated location. Under TH-2 no-show/cancellation disputes are system-final at the fixed $5.00, and under TH-1 an amount under $10 is system-final, so this is decided without human review. Confidence 0.92: the record (app event, GPS track, driver statement) settles the key element.

element_findings.element: Driver arrived at the pickup point (GPS within 200 m of Clarke Quay/Gate A, the designated pickup)
basis: driver_statement: pressed I'm Here at Gate B
element_findings.reason: The driver pressed arrival/Gate B while GPS places him stationary on Hill Street, a different road from the pickup road, refusing to come to Gate A. NS-1(i) not satisfied.

element_findings.element: Driver sent >=1 in-app message and made >=1 in-app call before cancelling
element_findings.reason: One call and multiple messages before the 21:32:00 cancellation satisfy NS-1(iii), but this does not cure the failure of (i).

element_findings.element: Free wait time elapsed before cancellation
element_findings.reason: ~6 minutes elapsed between arrival and cancellation, so NS-1(ii) is satisfied; the failure is on (i), so the fee is still voided under NS-2.

element_findings.element: Rider was a no-show (absent from the pickup point)
basis: chat_logs 21:27:50 rider: I'm at Gate A, can you come here?
element_findings.reason: The rider was present and asking to be collected; a rider waiting at the agreed side of the pickup area is not a no-show, so NS-1's premise fails and NS-3 also bars the fee.

rejected_claims.reason: The claim that he was at the pickup point is contradicted by GPS: he was stationary on HILL STREET (Gate B area), ~200 m+ on-road from the Clarke Quay/Gate A pickup point, and he refused to come to Gate A. The 'double yellow line' justification relates to Gate A, not to the street he was actually on.
The record shows the rider was present at Gate A and asking to be collected; the driver cancelled because he would not reposition to the rider's location, not because the rider failed to show.
